items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: I've played with John Kazma several times.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about the brass bands you've played with here. You're now a member of the Eureka Band, we know. Had you played much with some of the other brass bands down here a few years ago? I never met you until a couple years ago, I think.

I've played with George Williams. I've played with John Kazma several times. I've played with several mixed bands out of the union. Anything they have in town that they want to play. The business agent will tell you, well, who you got in the front there? Well, you got a chick up there, you don't need nobody else.
Any of them go, I can play with them. I wonder some of the dance bands that you've played with in New Orleans here, can you remember some of the musicians that you've played dances with?
